whyZenit.title: Why Zenit
whyZenit.subtitle: A school where students feel known, challenged, and supported.

paragraphs: Zenit School is built around a simple idea: when students feel known, challenged, and supported, they do their best work — and become their best selves.
We combine rigorous academics with purposeful character formation. Families choose Zenit for an environment that is calm, safe, and focused on growth.

director.title: From the Director
director.subtitle: A message for the families, students and wider Zenit School community.
paragraphs: Since Zenit School was founded in 2009, our aim has been to provide a structured academic environment in which every student is guided to build lasting knowledge and strong working habits.

A school’s responsibility extends beyond the transmission of knowledge. We work to help students develop independent thought, responsibility, collaboration and the ability to apply what they learn in practice.
Study Hour, projects in science and technology, web development, swimming, clubs, Olympiads and hackathons provide students with varied opportunities to learn, create and present their work.
Continuing cooperation with families is an important part of this process. I invite you to learn more about our school, its programmes and its community.

history.heading: Our Story Since 1985
paragraphs: Zenit School was founded with a vision to prepare students not just for academic success, but for leadership in an ever-changing world. From our beginnings with 50 students, we have grown into a premier institution serving 450 students from 35 countries.

Our founders believed in combining rigorous academics with character development—a philosophy that still guides our mission. The addition of our half Olympic pool in 1995 marked our commitment to wellness and competitive excellence.
